package ssa
import("fmt";"encoding/json";"runtime";"testing")
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T){
 var out []string
 var c Cache
 for _,n:=range []int{1,2,7,8,9,31,32,33,63,64,65,257}{
  blocks:=c.allocBlockSlice(n);i64:=c.allocInt64(n);ints:=c.allocIntSlice(n);i32:=c.allocInt32Slice(n);i8:=c.allocInt8Slice(n);bools:=c.allocBoolSlice(n);ids:=c.allocIDSlice(n);uints:=c.allocUintSlice(n);known:=c.allocKnownBitsEntriesSlice(n)
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("capacity:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d",n,cap(blocks),cap(i64),cap(ints),cap(i32),cap(i8),cap(bools),cap(ids),cap(uints),cap(known)))
  clean:=true
  for i:=0;i<n;i++{
   clean=clean&&blocks[i]==nil&&i64[i]==0&&ints[i]==0&&i32[i]==0&&i8[i]==0&&!bools[i]&&ids[i]==0&&uints[i]==0&&known[i]==(knownBitsEntry{})
   blocks[i]=&Block{ID:ID(i+1)};i64[i]=int64(i)*65539-7;ints[i]=i*31;i32[i]=int32(i)*-31;i8[i]=int8(i);bools[i]=i%2!=0;ids[i]=ID(i+1);uints[i]=uint(i)*17;known[i]=knownBitsEntry{known:int64(i),value:int64(i)*2}
  }
  runtime.GC()
  sum:=int64(0);for i:=0;i<n;i++{if blocks[i].ID!=ID(i+1){t.Fatal("GC lost block")};sum+=int64(blocks[i].ID)+i64[i]+int64(ints[i])+int64(i32[i])+int64(i8[i])+int64(ids[i])+int64(uints[i])+known[i].known+known[i].value;if bools[i]{sum++}}
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("values:%d:%t:%d",n,clean,sum))
  c.freeBlockSlice(blocks);c.freeInt64(i64);c.freeIntSlice(ints);c.freeInt32Slice(i32);c.freeInt8Slice(i8);c.freeBoolSlice(bools);c.freeIDSlice(ids);c.freeUintSlice(uints);c.freeKnownBitsEntriesSlice(known)
 }
 // Preserve the native empty-slice contract: derived allocators address the
 // first element and therefore panic for empty input, unlike the base pools.
 for _,item:=range []struct{name string;run func()}{
 {"block-zero",func(){c.allocBlockSlice(0)}},{"int-zero",func(){c.allocIntSlice(0)}},{"free-block-empty",func(){c.freeBlockSlice(nil)}},{"free-int-empty",func(){c.freeIntSlice(nil)}},
 }{func(){defer func(){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("panic:%s:%v",item.name,recover()))}();item.run()}()}
 data,err:=json.Marshal(out);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR="+string(data))
}
